desc: Establish basic monotonicity: occupied-square count cannot increase, and outermost occupied positions only move inward.
Reject ordered representative matching / bounded-displacement frontier criteria as complete: they ignore holes and fail reachable-state constraints.
Implement an exact small-N BFS oracle and verify that it passes all public samples.
Run and confirm exhaustive validation of the current assignment characterization, one-operation special case, and claimed minimum-operation formula through N=7.
Prove reachability conditions and the minimum-operation formula for the validated characterization.
Confirm and document the `feasible` complexity; replace its gap search with a range-successor structure only if an actual non-linear worst case remains.
Implement the production solver and validate it against samples and exhaustive small cases.
